hero.description: JCT Education Center provides immersive, certified language programs in Chinese (Mandarin), English, and Arabic for Non-Native Speakers, building cross-cultural bridges from Amman to the world.

home.welcomeSubtitle: A disciplined, student-centered approach to language acquisition
home.pillar1Desc: All our courses are benchmarked against internationally recognized frameworks including HSK levels and the Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR).
home.pillar2Desc: Strategically bridging Jordan, the Arab region, China, and international global business hubs through real-world linguistic immersion.
home.pillar3Desc: Focused class sizes guarantee personalized attention, active conversational drills, and consistent feedback from experienced instructors.
home.pillar4Desc: We prioritize active spoken fluency, listening comprehension, and professional terminology applicable immediately in academic and corporate settings.
home.featuredCoursesSubtitle: Specialized pathways tailored for academic, career, and diplomatic goals
home.bridgeTitle: A Cultural & Economic Gateway in Jordan
home.bridgeDesc: Jordan stands as a beacon of education and international diplomacy in the Middle East. At JCT Education Center, we leverage this vantage point to connect students, researchers, and professionals with East Asia and global multilingual opportunities.

about.title: Fostering Global Communication From Amman
about.intro: Established in Jordan, JCT Education Center is dedicated to delivering rigorous, culturally immersive language education that prepares students and professionals for an interconnected world.
about.missionDesc: To deliver exemplary language training in Chinese, English, and Arabic by combining proven linguistic methodologies, modern interactive teaching environments, and deep cultural appreciation.
about.visionDesc: To be Jordan's premier center for cross-cultural communication, unlocking academic, professional, and diplomatic horizons for students across the region.
about.value1Desc: Adhering to structured milestones and verified international language standards.
about.value2Desc: Understanding that true language fluency requires genuine cultural context and mutual understanding.
about.value3Desc: Prioritizing individual learner progress, active participation, and practical communicative ability.
about.value4Desc: Maintaining clear educational objectives, objective assessments, and authentic learning environments.
about.facilityDesc: Situated in Amman, Jordan, our center features modern multimedia classrooms, dedicated cultural resource corners, and collaborative seminar rooms designed for intensive language practice.

courses.subtitle: Discover tailored language curricula designed for academic advancement, professional careers, and cultural immersion.

categories.chineseDesc: Comprehensive Mandarin education from foundational Pinyin to advanced business negotiation and HSK certification.
categories.englishDesc: Dynamic courses covering general fluency, professional communication, and rigorous exam preparation.
categories.arabicDesc: Immersive instruction in Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) and Levantine/Jordanian colloquial Arabic.

approach.title: The JCT Learning Methodology
approach.subtitle: How our structured, communicative approach produces genuine fluency and confident speakers.
approach.pillar1Desc: Rather than rote memorization, our instruction emphasizes spontaneous dialogue, contextual role-playing, and immediate language production from Day 1.
approach.pillar2Desc: We cap classes at 8 to 12 learners, ensuring high frequency of teacher-student interaction, corrective feedback, and collaborative group tasks.
approach.pillar3Desc: Language cannot be decoupled from its cultural soul. We weave customs, non-verbal etiquette, calligraphy, idioms, and historical context into lessons.
approach.pillar4Desc: Transparent progress evaluations at regular intervals allow students to measure their advancement and target specific areas for refinement.
approach.step1Desc: Comprehensive assessment of speaking, listening, reading, and grammar to determine exact entry level.
approach.step2Desc: Intensive coursework combining interactive seminars, multimedia resources, and practical dialogue.
approach.step3Desc: Mid-term and end-of-level evaluations aligned with CEFR and HSK proficiency standards.
approach.step4Desc: Capstone conversational workshops, business simulations, or preparation for official external certification.
